exerciseDefinitions.exerciseName: Reverse Pec Deck / Rear Delt Fly
EZ-Bar Curl or Close-Grip Supinated Pulldown
Incline DB Curl or Hammer Curl
Seated Calf Raise or Tibialis Raise (3 × 15–20)
Chest Fly Machine or Low-to-High Cable Fly (3 × 12–15)
Dips (2–3 × 8–12) or cable high to low
Push-Up Finisher (1–2 sets close to failure)
Farmer’s Walk or Suitcase Carry (3 × 30–40 s)
DB Preacher Curl or Hammer Curl (3 × 10–12)
Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom
If you feel biceps more than back
Add reps or small weight every week
Reduce weight by 40–50% OR cut sets in half
